CRITICAL.title: Immediate Escalation to Authorized Human Responder
CRITICAL.rationale: High-priority crisis indicators or active danger detected requiring immediate real-time human intervention.

CRITICAL.title: Local Police Station / PCR Coordination Assessment
CRITICAL.rationale: Physical threat to life, active home confinement, or assault situation reported.

CRITICAL.title: Immediate Psychological First Aid (Tele-MANAS / NHAA Mental Health Desk)
CRITICAL.rationale: Severe acute distress or explicit suicidal/self-harm ideation.

HIGH.title: Priority Case Review by Senior Grievance Officer
HIGH.rationale: Severe intimidation, threat of retaliation, or significant vulnerability identified.

HIGH.title: District Legal Services Authority (DLSA) Fast-Track Referral
HIGH.rationale: SC/ST Prevention of Atrocities Act compliance, FIR registration support, or legal protection required.

HIGH.title: Witness Protection Scheme Evaluation
HIGH.rationale: Complainant or family under active retaliation threat from perpetrators.

MODERATE.title: Trauma-Informed Telephonic Counselling Referral
MODERATE.rationale: Noticeable emotional distress, ongoing anxiety, or sleep disturbances.

MODERATE.title: Rehabilitation & Social Welfare Scheme Check
MODERATE.rationale: Social boycott, economic disruption, or displacement vulnerability.

LOW.title: Standard Grievance Registration & Information Provision
LOW.rationale: No immediate physical threat or acute psychological distress observed.

LOW.title: Complaint Docket ID & Self-Service Portal Access
LOW.rationale: Standard grievance recording and status update protocol.
